bullets.text: Deadline Approaches for Zero-Rating - Mobile operators in South Africa must zero-rate social value content by January 2027.
EE Launches Fast Lane Service - EE's new 5G network slicing service ensures high-quality connectivity during peak times.
BT Supports Highlands Startups - A new programme aims to boost digital innovation in Scotland's rural areas.
BDUK Updates on Project Gigabit - Over 9,000 premises were connected last month under the £5 billion initiative.
Telecom AI Ambitions Lag - A survey reveals only a quarter of operators are ready to scale telecom AI initiatives.
